Mistress '''Alfara''' was the innkeeper of the [[Bellon Ford Inn]] in the town of [[Bellon]].

== Activities ==
When [[Elayne]] arrives with [[Nynaeve]] in the role of ladies maid, Mistress Alfara takes advantage by giving Nynaeve all the duties her staff might have performed.{{ref/book|5|13}}
